name: Survivor tee
summary: The chat designs its end-of-finals shirt together: everyone's design hangs on a clothesline with a clothespin and the one in front is shown big on a hanger; make yours by tapping the shirt to change the picture, picking a color and writing the line, hang it, then tap shirts on the line and give one your vote.
